body:
Found two real, complete, uncommitted PARENA mods from an earlier git-worktree-isolated agent (each file's own header comment asked whoever has git access to commit them): PRRJECT_FATBABY's eventstore cross-process append lock (fixes a real, confirmed sequence-collision bug -- 15 independent Go processes racing on the same event store) and PARENA's redgarden/combat_log_mod.prn (combat-log v2 trigger layer). Verified both compile/build/test clean before committing. PARENA commit 4709fdd, PRRJECT_FATBABY commit 75a02ed.

⚓ ☃
title: Recovered orphaned eventstore seqlock fix + REDGARDEN combat-log mod
